title: auth: check() takes password as plain &str, should zeroize
description: crates/auth/src/store.rs line 200: check(&self, username: &str, password: &str). Security-sensitive: password lives as a plain String heap allocation (line 211 clone for spawn_blocking) with no zeroization guarantee after bcrypt::verify completes. Should use secrecy::SecretString or a ZeroizeOnDrop wrapper.
notes: Fix: add secrecy dep; change to check(&self, username: &str, password: &SecretString). Call expose_secret() inside the spawn_blocking closure and let it drop. Update session/commands/auth.rs call sites.
